_about: Parent Training bench cases. Invented sessions, no client data. fields are typed into the page by label; truth answers the follow-up questions the page asks; expect and parentExpect are the checks (scripts/bench/lib/checks.mjs). Ported from tests/fixtures/parent-note-shape.json, whose v1 answers became truth.

fields.Session Notes:
Parent training.
Parent Goals:
1. Parent Goal: Use First-Then Language|At Home|5/0|100%
2. Parent Goal: Use First-Then Language|In the Community|4/0|100%
Caregiver used first-then language at the grocery store without a reminder from BCBA. Said "first cart, then snack" and client walked with the cart to checkout. Dad ran it at home during teeth brushing and bath. Parents said it feels automatic now. No barriers reported. Client Goals:
Waiting|2 minutes|4/0|100%
Waited in the checkout line with a visual timer, no behaviors. Discussed moving the waiting goal to 3 minutes next session. Mom asked for a first-then card to use at church on Sundays.

truth.answer: Mom used first-then at the grocery store on her own; BCBA was there and saw it.

parentExpect.caregiverResponse: Parent/Family is responding to training and generalization of skills is occurring. There are no barriers with their training.

fields.Session Notes:
Parent training, caregiver and client only. Follow up when the BT is present on fading the visual schedule.
Parent Goals:
1. Parent Goal: Follow Visual Schedule|Point to Next Picture|3/1|75%
Mom pointed to the next picture before 3 of 4 transitions. On the 4th, bath to bed, she skipped it and gave a vocal direction only. Client went anyway, no protest. Mom held each picture at chest height as practiced.
Client Goals:
Transitions Between Activities|with visual|3/0|100%
All transitions took under 1 min, no behaviors. Mom asked whether the schedule can drop to 3 pictures. Plan to try removing the first picture next week if the data hold.
